mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies hang over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 29 degrees that feels like 21. Look for a full moon tonight, and note that the ISS will pass overhead, though heavy clouds mean you won't be able to see it.

Property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th. The first installment is due January 31st to the City Treasurer, while the second is due July 31st to Dane County. Payments can be submitted online, by mail, via 24/7 drop boxes, or in person at City Center, and lottery credit applications are due January 30th.

Local events today include live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza specials at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow features ART House 360 Thursday nights and Hop Haus trivia, with the Crafty Fair coming up on November 28th.
In weekly police reports, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on East Verona Avenue and arrested a 34-year-old driver for O W I with a child passenger.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, where chocolate fans can stop by to enjoy today's flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate Decadence.
